fields.description:
This matte lipstick of the future! Matte Revolution lipstick is the revolutionary matte formula in a long-lasting, buildable lipstick, perfect for an effortlessly gorgeous makeup look!

What makes it magic?

- Get luminous, cashmere-soft lips in a matte finish with a slick of one lipstick
- A blend of oils, triglycerides and waxes give you buildable, long-lasting colour for up to 10 hours!
- Lipstick tree and orchid extract softens, protects and hydrates lips for younger-looking, healthy lips
- Revolutionary, square, angled tip mimics the shape of a lip brush for precision application
- 3D glowing pigments create an illusion of fuller, wider lips that glow from within
- Ideal for a hydrating, long-lasting matte lipstick for a soft, cashmere finish

fields.name: Kundan Pearl Jhumka Set
fields.description: A festive jhumka pair with kundan-style stones, pearl edging, and a comfortable push-back closure.
fields.short_description: Statement kundan jhumkas with pearl drops.
fields.ingredients: Alloy base, kundan-style stones, faux pearls, gold-tone polish. Keep away from perfume and water.
fields.how_to_use: Pair with lehenga, saree, or a plain kurta to make the earrings the highlight.

fields.name: Meenakari Lotus Jhumka
fields.description: Lightweight meenakari earrings with a lotus motif and tiny pearl accents for bright ethnic styling.
fields.short_description: Colorful lotus enamel jhumkas for festive looks.
fields.ingredients: Alloy base, enamel finish, faux pearls, gold-tone polish. Store in a dry pouch after use.
fields.how_to_use: Wear with pastel suits or printed kurtis for a fresh pop of color.

fields.name: Antique Temple Jhumka
fields.description: A rich antique jhumka design with carved detailing that works beautifully for pooja and wedding outfits.
fields.ingredients: Alloy base, antique gold polish, synthetic beads. Wipe gently with a soft dry cloth.
fields.how_to_use: Style with silk sarees, brocade dupattas, or temple necklaces.

fields.name: Royal Polki Choker Necklace
fields.description: A regal necklace set designed with polki-style stones, green bead drops, and an adjustable dori closure.
fields.short_description: Polki-style choker with emerald bead drops.
fields.ingredients: Alloy base, polki-style stones, synthetic emerald beads, gold-tone polish.
fields.how_to_use: Best with deep neck blouses, lehengas, or a classic black dress.

fields.name: Layered Pearl Necklace
fields.description: A graceful multi-layer necklace with ivory faux pearls and a secure lobster clasp.
fields.short_description: Soft layered pearls for elegant day-to-night looks.
fields.ingredients: Faux pearls, alloy chain, anti-tarnish gold-tone clasp. Keep in a separate pouch.
fields.how_to_use: Layer over satin shirts, gowns, or simple ethnic necklines.

fields.name: Minimal CZ Pendant Necklace
fields.description: A delicate chain necklace with a tiny CZ-style pendant for college, office, and gifting.
fields.short_description: Everyday pendant with a clean crystal sparkle.
fields.ingredients: Alloy chain, cubic zirconia-style stone, rhodium-tone polish.
fields.how_to_use: Wear solo for a minimal look or layer with a thin gold chain.

fields.name: Rose Gold Charm Bracelet
fields.description: A polished rose-gold bracelet with playful charms and an extender chain for a comfortable fit.
fields.short_description: Adjustable bracelet with delicate heart charms.
fields.ingredients: Alloy chain, rose-gold polish, crystal-style charms. Avoid sweat and moisture.
fields.how_to_use: Stack with a watch or wear solo with western outfits.

fields.name: Classic Kada Bracelet
fields.description: A sturdy kada bracelet with traditional patterning and an easy open-close clasp.
fields.short_description: Openable kada with antique carved detail.
fields.ingredients: Alloy base, antique polish, secure clasp. Clean with a dry microfiber cloth.
fields.how_to_use: Pair with jhumkas for ethnic looks or stack with slim bangles.

fields.name: Pearl Bead Bracelet
fields.description: An easy everyday bracelet with faux pearl beads and tiny gold spacers.
fields.short_description: Stretch bracelet with soft pearl shine.
fields.ingredients: Faux pearls, elastic cord, alloy spacer beads. Store flat to retain shape.
fields.how_to_use: Wear with watches, kurtis, or pastel dresses.

fields.name: Crystal Bangle Stack
fields.description: A set of four slim bangles finished with crystal-style detailing and a polished gold tone.
fields.short_description: Sparkling bangles for party and wedding looks.
fields.ingredients: Alloy bangles, crystal-style stones, gold-tone polish. Keep wrapped separately.
fields.how_to_use: Stack together or mix with plain bangles for a fuller wrist look.
